phases.title: Phase 1: Version Lock
phases.description: Block VM0007 evidence audit unless PDD-declared methodology version matches the loaded contract/rulebook version.

phases.title: Phase 2: Envira Quarantine
phases.description: Preserve Envira as a legacy v1.5 mismatch regression fixture, not validated truth.

phases.title: Phase 3: Report and PDF Blocking
phases.description: Prevent mismatched versions from producing normal evidence maps, reports, PDFs, or readiness claims.

phases.title: Phase 4: Gate Strengthening
phases.description: Add tests and gates so mismatches cannot produce judgments, reports, PDFs, or client-readiness output.

phases.title: Phase 5: Roadmap Correction
phases.description: Correct contaminated done states and mark VM0007 evidence-map work pending versioned re-audit.

phases.title: Phase 6: Forward Path
phases.description: Prepare a clean VM0007 v1.8 path such as Maya without building a full evidence map yet.
